title: Current A1 owner revalidation preserves the variational and heat-map blockers
question: After the Fourier convention correction, does the current A1 source select a canonical parent and supply the R-192 heat/root owner needed for QFT promotion?
method: Run the current A1 Class-II owner revalidation with unchanged primary and stdlib-only independent lanes, deriving current counts from the live catalog, ledgers and task registry.
Run the current-authority R-200 mobility/heat-root revalidation and the unchanged R-192 owner-order verifier after the 2*pi/L convention correction.
Inspect the historical R-193 wrapper failure separately and classify its old Lean-registry hash as reader staleness rather than mathematical evidence.

Apply the parent-selection firewall: do not use F_decl as if its residual were its real gradient, do not use F_ref as canonical without an authority decision, and do not promote static Gibbs or mobility data to a production heat/root map.
finding: The current A1 Class-II revalidation passes 18/18 and preserves the exact nonzero declared-versus-residual coefficient difference. R-200 current-authority revalidation passes 27/27 and preserves distinct heat rates compatible with the same static inverse-covariance data. R-192 passes its 58/58 internal checks but still returns FAIL_FIRST_MISSING_PRODUCTION_MAP at heat_root_incidence. The historical R-193 wrapper stops earlier on a stale Lean registry hash.
decision_reason: The current evidence does not select a canonical A1 functional or a canonical QFT production mobility. The correct disposition is to park all finite QFT candidates below the R-192 owner threshold and require an explicit parent decision plus a hash-pinned nonlinear heat/root map, filtration, replicas, raw-current identity and one-use q-ledger.
boundary: This is a T0 claim-nonbearing current-reader audit. It does not repair F_decl/F_ref, supply R-192 owner slots, close A13/T-050, establish an interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, select a physical vacuum, or close Sector-A or Pre-A.
next_action: Keep the parent choice explicit. Advance only when an authority hash-pins one complete A1 functional and a production mobility/heat-root map with the remaining R-192 owner slots; then rerun R-192 unchanged.
